note: Claim ledger. Each claim names a profile, one evidence tier, an artifact that exists, the profile fields it depends on and a standing. A claim that depends on a field tagged tier4-community, tier5-emulator-hint, inference or unknown-default-chosen is provisional. Vocabulary: docs/evidence-tiers.md.

claims.statement: On the CP-1600 manual's reading, a push writes the word at the address held in R6 and then increments R6, and a pull first decrements R6 and then reads, so the stack grows toward higher addresses.
claims.note: The expectation comes from three manual pages read in plan 01-02 (C17 resolved-primary). Applying the CP-1600 manual to the CP-1610 is an inference logged as C31 in the discrepancy log, so the claim stays provisional.
